quotes.author: Linda Terrell
quotes.text: Perfect day on the lake! The boat was beautiful.Our captain and first mate were awesome. Nice choice of drinks and a wonderful charcuterie board after the tour. The tour of Vikingshome was very cool we have hiked to and sailed by it in winter but never toured inside. My only complaint was the size of the tour group let inside the home made it very difficult to enjoy. We only had 16 on the boat but there were about 30 or so crammed into the house tour. ( I don’t think this was any fault of the boat tour though).

quotes.author: Shelly Becker
quotes.text: Cruise Tahoe’s classic wooden boat was a great way to get out on the lake. It was also a convenient way to access the Vikingsholm Castle in the stunning Emerald Bay. After the included tour of the castle we enjoyed tasty appetizers and ice cold drinks. Captain Adam and first hand Nick took special care of each of the guests special needs. We even got to met Ed the owner who was so helpful in arranging the reservation. If you want to “do it all” I highly recommend Cruise Tahoe.

quotes.author: Brad Van Beek
quotes.text: My wife and I had a great time on the M/V Tahoe cruising to Emerald Bay and touring the Vikingsholm Castle. Adam (the captain) and Nick were wonderful hosts and provided good narration of what we were seeing on the way to and from Emerald Bay. Being from the Seattle area, it was interesting to hear about the history of the Tahoe which was built in Seattle. Very nice historic boat and a treat to go out on Lake Tahoe on her. Thanks for a great afternoon on the lake.

quotes.author: Annie Mcdonnell
quotes.text: I have studied hospitality my entire life. To move to South Lake Tahoe and experience the lake via boat was a goal. I have now booked on Alpenglow and Tahoe and both were top notch amazing views and educational opportunities to learn of my new backyard. The crew is highly trained and very intuitive, dedicated to the BEST hospitality and overall great experience. 100/10 Such a great ONLY Wooden boat charter opportunity on the lake. Thank you!!!

quotes.author: Jan Mcbroom
quotes.text: We really enjoyed our recent cruise on Lake Tahoe with Captain Adam and Nick. Their knowledgeable information helped us enjoy the beautiful scenery even more. Relaxing, interesting, and fun! Enjoyed the snacks and refreshments as well! It was a great way to celebrate a milestone birthday. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Dj Sean Alan
quotes.text: This cruise is totally worth the money. Adam was an amazing guide and the sight seeing was world class. The Vikingslholm castle tour and boat ride were the highlights to our Tahoe trip this summer. Make sure and purchase through the website. I almost paid $50 more booking through trip advisor.
